report.thesis: The investable question is how much accepted GPU revenue survives hardware financing, replacement capex and dilution. Revenue growth can be strong while common-share cash generation remains negative.

models.method: Justin independent assumptions, not issuer guidance or consensus. Revenue=sum(quarter_revenue): Q1 actual228 plus three explicit forecast quarters; bear April acceptance, base February, bull January. FY27 capex=4824 Q1 hardware/PPE +15000 remaining plan. Pre-D&A gross contribution=revenue*gross_margin_ex_da. Analytical gross_profit=pre-D&A contribution minus ALL modeled D&A. Adjusted EBITDA proxy=pre-D&A contribution-cash_opex_ex_sbc; standardized EBITDA=adjusted proxy-stock_compensation. Net-income proxy=standardized EBITDA-D&A-net_interest-cash_tax, excluding fair-value gains. Standardized FCF=null because prepaid revenue recognition and new prepayments are unresolved. Supplemental pre-customer-financing cash proxy=adjusted EBITDA-net_interest-cash_tax-capex-working_capital_cash_use; not distributable cash or GAAP CFO-capex. Acceptance stress holds Q2 revenue flat for one extra quarter and shifts the modeled consolidated ramp back three months. Delayed FY27 quarters are 228, 240, 240, 250 million dollars. This isolates timing by assuming all growth over Q2 requires customer acceptance. With fixed costs, capex and tax unchanged, FY27 EBITDA changes by -439.2 million. If collected as earned, cash changes by -439.2 million. If already prepaid with no refund, cash changes by +170.8 million from avoided service costs. Customer billing dates and actual cash effects are unknown. Per-share effects assume the cash difference persists to valuation with FY28 EBITDA, claims and dilution fixed.

valuation.capital_basis: Debt, cash,500M other-claims buffer and500/550/650M diluted shares are explicit future sensitivities, not sourced forecasts. Financing rollforward is unresolved; no scenario probability or weighted target.
valuation.method: EV=FY2028 adjusted EBITDA*multiple; common equity=max(0,EV-assumed debt-finance leases + unrestricted cash - other claims); price=common equity/assumed diluted shares. Debt field already includes finance leases: subtract once.
valuation.multiple_basis: Author6/8/10x scenarios, not observed peer multiples. Lower multiple reflects replacement capex/contract runoff and execution risk; upper requires durable utilization and refinancing. EBITDA capitalizes neither full GPU replacement nor contracted debt service: cross-check negative FCF. Standardized EBITDA in model metrics includes SBC; scenario multiples here are on separately disclosed adjusted EBITDA only.
